"""Developer-only clean-checkout reentry proof. Never writes user preferences."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import wave

RUNTIME = ["WinAudioClean.ps1", "WinAudioClean.IO.ps1", "WinAudioClean.Settings.ps1",
           "WinAudioClean.Preview.ps1", "WinAudioClean.Batch.ps1", "WinAudioClean.Queue.ps1",
           "WinAudioClean.Output.ps1", "WinAudioClean.Launcher.ps1", "WinAudioClean.bat"]
BASELINE = "dfcbd559f91c1cf2adf09a9ff581a5dac359ea73"
FILTERS = "adeclip,highpass=f=80,adeclick,afftdn=nf=-25,agate=range=0.056:threshold=0.0056,dynaudnorm=f=200:g=11:p=0.85:m=20:s=12,loudnorm=I=-12:TP=-1.5"


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def record(path: Path, root: Path) -> dict:
    return {"path": path.relative_to(root).as_posix(), "sha256": sha(path.read_bytes()),
            "bytes": path.stat().st_size}


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    parser.add_argument("--revision", default=BASELINE)
    parser.add_argument("--git", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--ps51", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--ps7", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--ffmpeg", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--ffprobe", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--capture-directory", type=Path,
                        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "capture-final")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    repo = args.repo.resolve()
    capture = args.capture_directory.resolve()
    if not capture.is_relative_to(repo / ".wac-local" / "WAC-M3-06" / "reentry"):
        raise ValueError("Capture must remain within the owned ignored reentry directory.")
    capture.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    logs = capture / "logs"
    logs.mkdir()
    clone = capture / "checkout"
    commands = []
    raw = []
    started = time.time()
    summary = {"schemaVersion": 1, "task": "WAC-M3-06", "baseline": args.revision,
               "scope": "Fresh detached local clone and absent-preference synthetic single-file exports on both Windows hosts.",
               "limits": ["No new thread, remote fetch, installation or release build is performed by this harness.",
                          "Clone objects come from the maintained local Git repository at the parent-verified pushed revision.",
                          "Explicit output and an absent SettingsPath under isolated APPDATA avoid user Music and preferences.",
                          "Mode Raw and dependency/output/absent-settings paths are explicit; preset, loudness mode, encoding and cleaning are built-ins.",
                          "No manual Explorer drop, interview recording, UI gesture, listening or default-sound promotion is claimed."],
               "commands": commands, "cases": [], "raw_artifacts": raw,
               "harness": record(Path(__file__).resolve(), repo), "harness_argv": sys.argv}
    summary_path = capture / "summary.json"

    def save() -> None:
        summary["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.time() - started, 3)
        summary_path.write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    def call(identifier: str, argv: list[str], cwd: Path, env: dict | None = None,
             expected: int = 0, timeout: int = 90) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
        before = time.monotonic()
        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                                timeout=timeout, check=False)
        out, err = logs / (identifier + "-stdout.txt"), logs / (identifier + "-stderr.txt")
        out.write_bytes(result.stdout); err.write_bytes(result.stderr)
        raw.extend([record(out, repo), record(err, repo)])
        commands.append({"id": identifier, "argv": argv, "cwd": str(cwd),
                         "exit_code": result.returncode, "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - before, 3),
                         "stdout": record(out, repo), "stderr": record(err, repo)})
        save()
        if result.returncode != expected:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{identifier} exited {result.returncode}, expected {expected}; retained raw logs identify the failure.")
        return result

    def decoded(result: subprocess.CompletedProcess) -> str:
        return result.stdout.decode("utf-8-sig", errors="strict").strip()

    try:
        if args.revision != BASELINE:
            raise ValueError("This capture is scoped to the exact authorized pushed checkpoint.")
        if decoded(call("baseline-object-type", [args.git, "cat-file", "-t", args.revision], repo)) != "commit":
            raise ValueError("Baseline is not a local commit.")
        call("clone", [args.git, "clone", "--no-hardlinks", "--no-checkout", str(repo), str(clone)], repo)
        call("checkout", [args.git, "-C", str(clone), "checkout", "--detach", args.revision], repo)
        head = decoded(call("clone-head", [args.git, "rev-parse", "HEAD"], clone))
        clean_before = decoded(call("clone-status-before", [args.git, "status", "--porcelain"], clone)) == ""
        detached = decoded(call("clone-branch", [args.git, "branch", "--show-current"], clone)) == ""
        if head != args.revision or not clean_before or not detached:
            raise ValueError("Fresh checkout is not clean/detached at the authorized checkpoint.")
        summary["clone"] = {"path": str(clone), "head": head, "detached": detached,
                            "clean_before": clean_before, "origin_kind": "local object copy, not a new remote verification"}
        plan_root = clone / "docs/codex/winaudioclean"
        for action in ("validate-plan", "next"):
            response = call(action, [sys.executable, str(plan_root / "tools/handoff.py"), action,
                                     "--plan-root", str(plan_root)], clone)
            summary[action] = json.loads(decoded(response))
        if summary["validate-plan"] != {"valid": True, "tasks": 30, "acceptance_cases": 90, "improvements": 20}:
            raise ValueError("Canonical inventory did not recover from Git.")
        if [r["id"] for r in summary["next"]["ready"]] != ["WAC-M3-06"] or summary["next"]["blocked"]:
            raise ValueError("Reentry did not recover the exact next task.")
        tasks = json.loads((plan_root / "TASKS.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        acceptance = json.loads((plan_root / "ACCEPTANCE.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        summary["recovered_state"] = {"tasks": len(tasks["tasks"]), "cases": len(acceptance["cases"]),
            "done": sum(t["status"] == "done" for t in tasks["tasks"]),
            "todo": sum(t["status"] == "todo" for t in tasks["tasks"]),
            "M3-06": next(t for t in tasks["tasks"] if t["id"] == "WAC-M3-06"),
            "acceptance": [c for c in acceptance["cases"] if c["id"] in ("AC-064", "AC-065", "AC-066")],
            "read_first": [record(clone / p, repo) for p in ("AGENTS.md", "docs/codex/winaudioclean/STATUS.md",
               "docs/codex/winaudioclean/NEXT_MODEL_START_HERE.md", "docs/codex/winaudioclean/DECISIONS.md",
               "docs/codex/winaudioclean/TASKS.yaml", "docs/codex/winaudioclean/SYNC_PROTOCOL.md",
               "docs/codex/winaudioclean/tasks/WAC-M3-06.md")]}
        runtime = []
        for name in RUNTIME:
            original = call("baseline-" + name, [args.git, "show", args.revision + ":" + name], repo).stdout
            fresh = (clone / name).read_bytes()
            row = {"file": name, "git_blob_sha256": sha(original), "checkout_sha256": sha(fresh),
                   "bytes_equal": fresh == original,
                   "normalized_equal": fresh.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n") == original.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n"),
                   "normalized_sha256": sha(fresh.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n"))}
            if not row["normalized_equal"]:
                raise ValueError("Tracked runtime differs from the checkpoint: " + name)
            runtime.append(row)
        summary["runtime"] = runtime
        tool_rows = {}
        for name, path in (("ffmpeg", args.ffmpeg.resolve()), ("ffprobe", args.ffprobe.resolve())):
            result = call(name + "-version", [str(path), "-version"], repo)
            version = decoded(result).splitlines()[0]
            if "version 9.0.2" not in version:
                raise ValueError("Native tool is outside the pinned 9.0.2 scope.")
            tool_rows[name] = {"path": str(path), "sha256": sha(path.read_bytes()), "version": version}
        git_version = decoded(call("git-version", [args.git, "--version"], repo))
        summary["tools"] = {**tool_rows, "git": {"path": args.git, "sha256": sha(Path(args.git).read_bytes()),
                                                       "version": git_version},
            "python": {"path": sys.executable, "sha256": sha(Path(sys.executable).read_bytes()),
                       "version": sys.version.split()[0]}}
        fixture = capture / "synthetic-stereo.wav"
        frames, rate = 384000, 48000
        import struct
        with wave.open(str(fixture), "wb") as writer:
            writer.setnchannels(2); writer.setsampwidth(2); writer.setframerate(rate)
            pcm = bytearray()
            for index in range(frames):
                seconds = index / rate
                envelope = 0.36 + 0.24 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 0.8 * seconds) ** 2
                left = int(16000 * envelope * (math.sin(2 * math.pi * 311 * seconds) + 0.28 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 733 * seconds)))
                right = int(15000 * envelope * (math.sin(2 * math.pi * 419 * seconds) + 0.23 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 887 * seconds)))
                pcm.extend(struct.pack("<hh", left, right))
            writer.writeframes(pcm)
        summary["fixture"] = {**record(fixture, repo), "kind": "deterministic synthetic stereo tones with amplitude modulation",
                              "rate": rate, "channels": 2, "frames": frames, "seconds": frames / rate}
        native_versions_before = {name: sha(args.ffmpeg.resolve().read_bytes()) if name == "ffmpeg" else sha(args.ffprobe.resolve().read_bytes()) for name in ("ffmpeg", "ffprobe")}
        probe_command = "[ordered]@{version=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString();edition=$PSVersionTable.PSEdition;environmentApplicationData=$env:APPDATA;knownApplicationData=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('ApplicationData')} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
        for label, exe in (("ps51", args.ps51), ("ps7", args.ps7)):
            case_root = capture / label
            case_root.mkdir()
            appdata, localappdata, output = case_root / "appdata", case_root / "localappdata", case_root / "output"
            for p in (appdata, localappdata, output): p.mkdir()
            settings_dir = appdata / "WinAudioClean"
            settings_dir.mkdir()
            settings = settings_dir / "settings.json"
            env = dict(os.environ)
            env.update(APPDATA=str(appdata), LOCALAPPDATA=str(localappdata), PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8")
            host = json.loads(decoded(call(label + "-environment", [exe, "-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive",
                                       "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command", probe_command], repo, env)))
            row = {"id": label + "-clean-defaults", "host": {"path": exe, "sha256": sha(Path(exe).read_bytes()), **host},
                   "environment": {"APPDATA": str(appdata), "LOCALAPPDATA": str(localappdata)},
                   "appdata_matches_known_folder": str(appdata).casefold() == host["knownApplicationData"].casefold(),
                   "settings_path": str(settings), "settings_absent_before": not settings.exists()}
            argv = [exe, "-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File",
                    str(clone / "WinAudioClean.ps1"), "-inputPath", str(fixture), "-Mode", "Raw",
                    "-OutputDirectory", str(output), "-SettingsPath", str(settings), "-NonInteractive",
                    "-FfmpegPath", str(args.ffmpeg.resolve()), "-FfprobePath", str(args.ffprobe.resolve())]
            result = call(label + "-application", argv, clone, env, timeout=120)
            row["application_exit"] = result.returncode
            row["settings_absent_after"] = not settings.exists()
            row["isolated_preferences_file_count"] = len(list(appdata.rglob("*settings.json")))
            reports = list(output.glob("WinAudioClean_*.json"))
            assets = list(output.glob("*.wav"))
            if len(reports) != 1 or len(assets) != 1:
                raise ValueError(label + " did not produce exactly one detailed report and one export.")
            report = json.loads(reports[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
            row["report"] = {**record(reports[0], repo), "fields": report}
            with wave.open(str(assets[0]), "rb") as reader:
                encoded = {"rate": reader.getframerate(), "channels": reader.getnchannels(),
                           "bits": reader.getsampwidth() * 8, "frames": reader.getnframes(),
                           "pcm_sha256": sha(reader.readframes(reader.getnframes()))}
            row["asset"] = {**record(assets[0], repo), **encoded}
            settings_fields = report["settings"]
            row["checks"] = {
                "success": report["status"] == "SUCCESS" and report["applicationExitCode"] == 0,
                "default_preset": report["presetId"] == "original" and report["presetVersion"] == "1.0.0" and not report["presetExperimental"] and not report["presetCustomized"],
                "default_fast": settings_fields["loudnessMode"] == "Fast",
                "default_encoding": settings_fields["bitDepth"] == 16 and not settings_fields["mono"] and not settings_fields["rf64"],
                "default_graph": settings_fields["exactFilters"] == FILTERS,
                "original_cleaning": settings_fields["cleaning"]["schemaVersion"] == 1 and all(settings_fields["cleaning"][key] is True for key in ("Declip", "Declick", "Denoise", "Gate")),
                "settings_still_absent": row["settings_absent_before"] and row["settings_absent_after"] and row["isolated_preferences_file_count"] == 0,
                "published_valid": report["output"]["published"] is True and report["output"]["validity"] == "PASSED",
                "default_riff48k16_stereo": encoded["rate"] == rate and encoded["bits"] == 16 and encoded["channels"] == 2 and assets[0].read_bytes()[:4] == b"RIFF",
                "exact_duration": encoded["frames"] == frames,
                "source_unchanged": sha(fixture.read_bytes()) == summary["fixture"]["sha256"],
                "reports_complete": report["reporting"]["complete"] is True,
                "no_job_folder": "organization" not in report["output"] and not list(output.glob("WinAudioClean_Job_*")),
                "no_partials": not list(output.glob("*.partial")),
                "no_cancellation": report["progress"]["cancellationRequested"] is False,
                "completed_after_publication": report["progress"]["completed"] is True and report["progress"]["stages"][-1]["stage"] == "Completed" and report["progress"]["stages"][-1]["percent"] == 100,
            }
            row["passed"] = all(row["checks"].values())
            summary["cases"].append(row)
            raw.extend([record(reports[0], repo), record(assets[0], repo)])
            for p in output.glob("*.txt"): raw.append(record(p, repo))
            save()
            if not row["passed"]:
                raise ValueError(label + " had a failed recorded assertion.")
        summary["same_build_pcm_equal"] = summary["cases"][0]["asset"]["pcm_sha256"] == summary["cases"][1]["asset"]["pcm_sha256"]
        clean_after = decoded(call("clone-status-after", [args.git, "status", "--porcelain"], clone)) == ""
        summary["clone"]["clean_after"] = clean_after
        summary["clone"]["head_after"] = decoded(call("clone-head-after", [args.git, "rev-parse", "HEAD"], clone))
        summary["runtime_unchanged_after"] = all(sha((clone / r["file"]).read_bytes()) == r["checkout_sha256"] for r in runtime)
        summary["tools_unchanged_after"] = all(sha(Path(tool_rows[n]["path"]).read_bytes()) == native_versions_before[n] for n in native_versions_before)
        summary["status"] = "pass" if clean_after and summary["runtime_unchanged_after"] and summary["tools_unchanged_after"] and summary["same_build_pcm_equal"] else "fail"
        save()
        print(json.dumps({"status": summary["status"], "cases": len(summary["cases"]), "head": head,
                          "clean_before": clean_before, "clean_after": clean_after,
                          "pcm_equal": summary["same_build_pcm_equal"],
                          "appdata_known_folder_matches": [r["appdata_matches_known_folder"] for r in summary["cases"]]}, indent=2))
        if summary["status"] != "pass": raise ValueError("Final aggregate guard failed.")
    except Exception as error:
        summary["status"] = "fail"
        summary["error"] = str(error)
        save()
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Publish only sanitized metadata/source/log derivatives from owned reentry."""
from __future__ import annotations
import copy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
CAPTURE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "capture-final"
EVIDENCE = REPO / "docs/codex/winaudioclean/evidence"
SUMMARY = CAPTURE / "summary.json"
HARNESS = Path(__file__).with_name("run-reentry.py")
PREFIX = "WAC-M3-06-reentry"


def digest(path: Path) -> dict:
    return {"path": path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "bytes": path.stat().st_size}


def sanitize_text(value: str) -> str:
    components = str(REPO).replace("\\", "/").split("/")
    pattern = r"[\\/]+".join(re.escape(x) for x in components)
    value = re.sub(pattern, "<repo>", value, flags=re.I)
    value = re.sub(r"C:[\\/]+Users[\\/]+[^\\/\"\r\n]+", "<user-profile>", value, flags=re.I)
    value = re.sub("<user>", "<user>", value, flags=re.I)
    return value


def sanitize(value):
    if isinstance(value, str): return sanitize_text(value)
    if isinstance(value, list): return [sanitize(x) for x in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict): return {k: sanitize(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    return value


def write(path: Path, value: str) -> None:
    text = "\n".join(x.rstrip() for x in value.replace("\r\n", "\n").splitlines()).rstrip() + "\n"
    if re.search(r"C:[\\/]+(?:Users|projects)[\\/]+|<user>|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|\ufffd", text, re.I):
        raise ValueError("Privacy/encoding scan rejected " + path.name)
    path.write_bytes(text.replace("\n", "\r\n").encode("utf-8"))


def write_json(path: Path, value: dict) -> None:
    write(path, json.dumps(sanitize(value), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


def main() -> None:
    original = json.loads(SUMMARY.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if original["status"] != "pass" or len(original["cases"]) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Only the complete passing two-host capture is published here.")
    metadata = copy.deepcopy(original)
    metadata["acceptance_ids"] = ["AC-066"]
    metadata["acceptance_scope"] = "Objective reentry only; no claim that all WAC-M3-06 acceptance cases are complete."
    metadata["raw_capture"] = digest(SUMMARY)
    metadata["publication_history"] = json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name("publisher-initial-failure.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    metadata["appdata_observation"] = (
        "APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA were isolated, but both actual .NET ApplicationData known-folder reads retained the OS profile location. "
        "An explicit absent SettingsPath within the isolated APPDATA directory was supplied for both actual applications, "
        "so no personal configuration was read and no preferences were created. This does not claim environment variables redirected the OS known folder.")
    metadata["counts"] = {"cases": 2, "passed": 2, "runtime_files": len(original["runtime"]),
                          "published_case_wavs": 2, "detailed_reports": 2,
                          "same_build_cross_host_pcm_equal": original["same_build_pcm_equal"]}
    logs = []
    for label in ("ps51", "ps7"):
        out = CAPTURE / "logs" / (label + "-application-stdout.txt")
        err = CAPTURE / "logs" / (label + "-application-stderr.txt")
        destination = EVIDENCE / (PREFIX + "-" + label + ".txt")
        value = f"{label} actual single-file application; stdout then stderr. Raw byte hashes identify the originals.\n\n"
        value += out.read_bytes().decode("utf-8-sig") + "\n\nSTDERR:\n" + err.read_bytes().decode("utf-8-sig")
        write(destination, sanitize_text(value))
        logs.append({"raw_stdout": digest(out), "raw_stderr": digest(err), "published": digest(destination)})
    metadata["published_logs"] = logs
    source = HARNESS.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    invocation = [original["tools"]["python"]["path"], "-X", "utf8", *original["harness_argv"]]
    harness_bundle = {"schemaVersion": 1, "task": "WAC-M3-06", "developmentOnly": True,
                      "language": "Python 3.14", "tested_harness": digest(HARNESS),
                      "source": source, "reproduction_invocation": invocation,
                      "invocation_provenance": "sys.argv was captured by the tested harness; interpreter and -X utf8 are recorded from its actual developer invocation.",
                      "reproduction_notice": "Choose a new unused owned capture-directory for a rerun. No source-only checkout, user preferences or external directories are deleted.",
                      "publisher": digest(Path(__file__).resolve()),
                      "publisher_source": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")}
    main_path = EVIDENCE / (PREFIX + ".json")
    harness_path = EVIDENCE / (PREFIX + "-harness.json")
    write_json(main_path, metadata)
    write_json(harness_path, harness_bundle)
    manifest = {"schemaVersion": 1, "task": "WAC-M3-06", "scope": "Two-host objective clean-checkout reentry derivatives only.",
                "public_artifacts": [digest(main_path), digest(harness_path), *[x["published"] for x in logs]],
                "raw_capture": digest(SUMMARY), "tested_harness": digest(HARNESS),
                "publisher": digest(Path(__file__).resolve()), "raw_local_artifacts": original["raw_artifacts"],
                "notice": "Raw paths identify ignored local synthetic audio/reports/logs by byte hashes. No binary, recording, source checkout or personal path is published. Raw and sanitized hashes are distinct."}
    write_json(EVIDENCE / (PREFIX + "-manifest.json"), manifest)
    print(json.dumps({p.name: digest(p) for p in (main_path, harness_path, EVIDENCE / (PREFIX + "-manifest.json"))}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__": main()
